text:
Talia (Product): Quick sync — I just uploaded the PRD for the 'Scoped Inference Rollout' here: https://redwood.internal/prd/scoped-inference. Need cross-team review on acceptance criteria, edge cases, and launch criteria. Two customer-driven asks: Customer A needs PII redaction guarantees and audit logs; Customer B needs predictable latency under 95th pct. Proposed rollout: canary 5% (dedicated), 25% (mixed), then full. Can the teams confirm feasibility by EOD Friday?

Alex M (Eng): Quick q — PRD lists p50=200ms p95=700ms. Is that intended to be hosted-only? For Dedicated/Dedicated-burst we should set separate SLO rows. Also need a concrete canary rollback plan and an A/B experiment plan.

Samir (Infra): Re: canary — we need a reserved burst profile for GPUs during the 5% window, otherwise autoscaler will warm up too slow. Also PRD doesn't mention KMS/HSM flow for Private. We should add a short KMS requirements section.

Marta (ML): Edge cases: model skew after deploy (drift), tokenizer changes, and version incompatibilities with KV cache. Add: frozen eval set, synthetic regression tests, and a pinned fallback model list. We should include an automatic rollback if eval score drops > 3 pts.

Jess (Support): Customer A: they will require audit log retention 90 days and an opt-out path for PII processing. They're also shipping a campaign in early May, so timeline is tight — please flag anything that would block their signoff.

Kevin (Design): UX acceptance criteria: clear failure state with retry CTA, plus a lightweight modal explaining processing and opt-out. Attached mock: https://redwood.internal/design/modal-firewall.png

pm-bot: PRD review checklist created: 
- [ ] Acceptance criteria present
- [ ] SLO matrix defined
- [ ] Rollout & rollback steps
- [ ] Security/KMS callouts
- [ ] Support runbook placeholder

deploy-bot: Tentative deploy window posted: 2025-05-02 02:00-04:00 UTC (subject to sign-off and QA).

Talia (Product): Good notes. I'll update the PRD to include an SLO matrix per deployment type and add KMS + audit log sections. Who will own the canary runbook and rollback playbook? @Alex M (Eng) / @Samir (Infra)?

Alex M (Eng): I can draft the runbook w/ Samir. I'll include verification checks (latency, error rate, regression eval) and step-by-step rollback commands. Target internal beta next Wed if infra can reserve burst.

Samir (Infra): OK to reserve burst for an internal beta Wed, but need frozen infra config by Mon COB. I'll add autoscale knobs and GPU reservation steps to the runbook.

Marta (ML): I'll freeze the eval set by Mon and prepare the regression harness. Will also publish the fallback-model list (v1.3 pinned primary, fallback v1.1).

Jess (Support): I'll sync with Customer A and confirm marketing dates + communicate the opt-out flow. I'll also prepare the support playbook for likely error scenarios.

Talia (Product): Decision log (summary): SLOs: hosted p50=200ms/p95=700ms; dedicated p50=300ms/p95=900ms. Rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated health checks at each step. Model handling: pin primary model version with explicit fallback list. Security: KMS integration + audit logs required for Customer A. Owners: runbook -> Alex/Samir, eval/regressions -> Marta, customer coordination -> Jess, UX -> Kevin. I'll push updated PRD and tag for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:
